title: Emotion and delivery density (full expressive range)
description: Jev classifies delivery path and scores density. The heavy model writes tags. Do not omit dramatic or musical paths from this rubric — presets skip-list them instead.

delivery_path.instructions: Which delivery path fits this turn given genre, beat purpose, and the words themselves?

criteria.conversational: Two people talking. Light pauses, maybe a chuckle. No performance stunt.
criteria.punchy_emphasis: A number, a verdict, or a contradiction that wants stress, loud/emphasis, or a short pause — not tears and not song.
criteria.laugh_playful: The line is actually funny or the hosts are catching each other. Laugh, chuckle, giggle, or laugh-speak belong here.
criteria.whisper_intimate: A secret, an aside, or a confidence. Whisper or soft. Not a gimmick on a public fact.
criteria.somber_cry: Grief, loss, apology, or a weight the hosts would not joke about. Cry, sigh, exhale, decrease-intensity, lower-pitch are in-bounds. Inappropriate on a cheerful changelog.
criteria.musical_sung: The beat is a hook, jingle, sung interlude, or playful sing-song disclaimer. singing, sing-song, or hum-tune belong here. Inappropriate on a straight product brief unless the source material is itself a song.
criteria.intense_build: A rising argument or reveal. build-intensity, loud, fast. Must still be one idea.
criteria.overacted_reject: Tags are stacked for their own sake, or the path fights the words (crying on a pricing table, singing a CVE).

tag_density.instructions: Where does this turn sit on expressive density relative to a credible human conversation in this genre?
criteria: Barren: zero tags, dead TTS, no breath or pause. Generic audiobook mush.
Stiff: one pause maybe, still sounds read.
Alive-sparse: a well-placed pause, emphasis, or small laugh. Default target for informative / educational.
Alive-rich: several tags that a real host would actually do. Default target for comedy, narrative peaks, dramatic scenes.
Tag soup: almost every clause wrapped or punctuated. Over-acted; credibility breaks.

flat_vs_overacted.instructions: Is the performance flat, naturally alive, or over-acted?
criteria: Naturally alive. Laughs, hmms, pauses, emphasis where a person would.
Heightened but still a person you would believe in the room.
Over-acted. Community-theater or parody of emotion.

credibility_holds.instructions: Would a skeptical listener believe this speaker knows the material and is not performing a cartoon of feeling?

criteria.true: Emotion matches the claim. Tags support the line. No fake intimacy on a spec sheet.
criteria.false: Crying, singing, whispering, or laugh-stacking that the content does not earn — or no emotion at all on a line that needs a pulse.

somber_path_ok.instructions: Is a somber/cry path (cry, sigh, decrease-intensity, lower-pitch) appropriate for this turn?

criteria.true: The turn is about loss, harm, apology, death, or a moral weight. A dry read would be the dishonest choice.
criteria.false: The turn is a product fact, a joke, a tutorial step, or light banter. Cry/sigh would be unearned.

musical_path_ok.instructions: Is a musical/sung path (singing, sing-song, hum-tune) appropriate for this turn?

criteria.true: The beat is explicitly a song, jingle, hummed think-pause, or playful sung button the show format allows.
criteria.false: The beat is spoken exposition. Singing it would sound like a bit the hosts did not agree to.

code_notes: Branch on delivery_path first. If overacted_reject, rewrite — do not render.
If somber_path_ok noul is below preset.jev_thresholds.somber_path_noul_min, strip cry/sigh-heavy tags and rewrite spoken.
If musical_path_ok noul is below preset.jev_thresholds.musical_path_noul_min, strip singing/sing-song/hum-tune.
Informative presets like roberto-agent skip-list those tags so they never reach TTS unless a later human opt-in exists.
